'''Bok Askol''' was a [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]]<ref name="CSWE" /> factotum<ref name="RoguesGallery">{{InsiderCite|131|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: An Audience of Aliens}}</ref> and [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] mechanic<ref name="VD" /> who was a visitor<ref name="CSWE" /> of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="MosEspa">{{DB|location|mosespa|Mos Espa}}</ref> At [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]], the gene configuration of a Pacithhip usually indicated that they were to become either a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]], an intellectual, or a warrior, but Askol's destiny eluded classification<ref name="CSWE" /> and became a mystery for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Bok Askol}}</ref> Askol had [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="VD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bok.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Bok Askol in the customizable card game, where Askol was first identified.]]
Bok Askol first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> On [[May 3]], 1999,<ref name="Collector">{{CollectorCite|6|Around the Galaxy}}</ref>  the character was first pictured through the first series of Star Wars: Episode I Widevision cards produced by collectable company [[Topps]].<ref name="Intergalactic">{{Topps|set=1999 Topps Star Wars: Episode I Widevision Series 1|cardname=47 - Intergalactic Spectators|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73014/cid/5263457/1999-Topps-Widevision-Star-Wars:-Episode-I-47-Intergalactic-Spectators}}</ref>

A Pacithhip wearing a yellow shirt identified as a prospector in [[2000]],<ref name="Calendar">{{Decipher|url=youngjedi/cardlists/index.html|text=Young Jedi Collectible Card Game}}</ref> through the [[Battle of Naboo (YJCCG)|Battle of Naboo]] set of the [[Young Jedi Collectible Card Game]], was identified as Bok Askol<ref name="CCG" /> in [[2001]],<ref name="Decipher">{{Decipher|url=starwars/expansions/theedpalace/index.html|text=Theed Palace}}</ref> with the release of the [[Theed Palace Limited]] set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />

In the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" section of ''[[Star Wars Insider 131]]'', written by [[Leland Chee]]<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> and released on [[January 31]], [[2012]],<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=news/star_wars_insider_131/index.html|text=''Star Wars Insider'' Celebrates The Phantom Menace}}</ref> a Pacithhip wearing a green jumpsuit identified as a mechanic in the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and released on [[September 15]], 1999,<ref name="DK">{{DK|subdomain=us|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,11_0789447010,00.html|text=Star Wars Episode 1: Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref> is identified as Askol.<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> This article assumes the Rogues Gallery identification to be correct as it is the most recent source.
